author: Lees, J.P. and others
title: Measurement of an Excess of Bbar --> D(*) tau- nu_tau Decays and Implications for Charged Higgs Bosons
abstract: Based on the full BABAR data sample, we report improved measurements of the ratios R(D) = B(Bbar --> D tau- nu_tau) / B(Bbar --> D l- nu_l) and R(D*) = B(Bbar --> D* tau- nu_tau) / B(Bbar --> D* l- nu_l), where l denotes either an electron or a muon. These ratios are sensitive to potential contributions from charged Higgs bosons in 2HDM scenarios. We obtain R(D) = 0.440 +/- 0.058 +/- 0.042 and R(D*) = 0.332 +/- 0.024 +/- 0.018. The results exceed the Standard Model expectations by 2.0 sigma for R(D) and 2.7 sigma for R(D*), and combined by 3.4 sigma. The results are consistent with the presence of a charged Higgs boson contribution.
